Prices will drop; but selling credit 3 gives 22.5 promissory, paid next round before... promissory added to cash at round start 3, then cash devaluation applies to cash before adding promissory. Promissory is good—sell_credit 3 → 22.5 alashi next round, no tax. Also counter drops to 7. Alternatively sell for cash 18, devalued floor/100*62 → ~11. So credit better. Choice 6.
